partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: GOF activated-effector blockade
results.hypothesis: A drug can correct GOF signaling by suppressing an effector that the causal driver upregulates.
results.body: GOF driver upregulates effector; drug directly binds and decreases effector activity or abundance
results.mechanism_rationale: The drug blocks a signed activated downstream arm of an explicit GOF driver.
results.cypher:
MATCH (driver:Gene)-[regulation:REGULATES]->(effector:Gene)
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(effector)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(effector)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE driver <> effector
  AND 'infores:signor' IN
      coalesce(regulation.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND regulation.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND regulation.object_direction_qualifier IN
      ['upregulated', 'downregulated']
  AND regulation.object_direction_qualifier = 'upregulated'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = CASE regulation.object_direction_qualifier
  WHEN 'upregulated' THEN 'decreased'
  ELSE 'increased'
END
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
